sloka: तस्य नानद्यमानस्य श्रुत्वा निनदमद्भुतम्।लङ्कास्था राक्षसाः सर्वे न शेकुः स्पन्दितुं भयात् ।। ६.७४.४७ ।।
transliteration: tasya nānadyamānasya śrutvā ninadamadbhutam।laṅkāsthā rākṣasāḥ sarve na śekuḥ spandituṁ bhayāt ।। 6.74.47 ।।

translations.english: All the Rakshasas in Lanka hearing the loud roar of Hanuman were afraid and could not stir from there.
